subject: Graviton pricing deck and next steps
body_preview: Quick follow-up to confirm you received the pricing deck I sent after our discovery call — happy to walk through the numbers live this week.
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Monica Tan <monica.tan@graviton.ai>, Paul Richards <paul.richards@graviton.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Graviton pricing deck and next steps

Hi Monica / Paul —

Thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Per our conversation, attached is a pricing deck that maps the scope we discussed to three deployment profiles (Hosted API, Dedicated reserved capacity, and Private VPC). Highlights: 

- Recommended starter profile: Dedicated (2x A4000 equiv) for predictable latency at pilot scale
- Estimated monthly run rate (tokens + infra) for the PoC: $11k–14k depending on query mix
- Optional add-ons: extended observability retention, SOC2 evidence package (procurement often requests)

Next steps I suggested on the call:
1) You confirm which profile aligns with your procurement preference (hosted vs dedicated).
2) We schedule a 30-min walkthrough where Jordan (solutions) can step through the assumptions in the estimate and we can tailor memory/throughput tradeoffs.

Let me know times that look good next week — I can do morning PT on Tue/Wed/Thu.

Attachments: Graviton-Pricing-2026-08.pdf, redwood-one-pager.pdf

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
https://www.redwood.com

Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Graviton pricing deck and next steps — quick check-in

Hi Monica —

Quick nudge on the deck I sent earlier this week. Wanted to confirm you received the files and to check if timing/priority has shifted on your side. If helpful, we can:

- Do a focused 20–30 minute walk-through of the estimate and tailoring options
- Produce a one-page simplified cost summary for procurement (I included a draft one-pager attached previously)

Would Thu 9/2 at 9:30am PT or Fri 9/3 at 10am PT work for a quick call? If your team needs more time, happy to circle back in two weeks.

Best,
Neha

Hi Monica / Paul —

Jordan here (Solutions Engineer, looping in to help accelerate any technical questions the procurement or infra teams may have). A couple helpful items we can provide immediately if useful:

- Simplified one-page estimate that calls out committed vs burst costs
- Short SOC2 / security FAQ (two-page) and contact info for our security reviewer for deeper audit conversations

If you have an internal deadline or procurement window, tell us and we’ll prioritize the one-pager + FAQ. I’m available today between 11:00–12:30 PT and 3:00–4:30 PT for a quick sync; otherwise happy to fit whatever works for your team.

HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/GRV-2026-0091

Cc: Paul Richards <paul.richards@graviton.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Graviton pricing deck and next steps — quick check-in

Hi Neha / Jordan —

Thanks — confirm we received the deck. Apologies for the slow reply; our product team is heads-down on Q4 planning. A couple asks from procurement:

1) Can you send a one-page estimate that shows committed vs burst pricing and a short table of included observability metrics?
2) We’ll need the SOC2 evidence packet and a point of contact for an audit call (we schedule vendor reviews on the 3rd Friday of the month).

If you can get the one-pager and SOC2 FAQ over by EOD Thu 9/9, I can flag it to procurement and try to schedule a call for Fri 9/17. Otherwise we’ll need to bump to the following cycle.

Best,
Monica Tan
Head of Product | Graviton Analytics
monica.tan@graviton.ai
